mandate: C319 — test the cross-sectional COINTEGRATION / PAIRS mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -mispricing, long cheap/short rich): spread_z (rolling hedge-ratio residual z vs equal-weight market), spread_zxs (cross-sectionally demeaned z / relative value), z_hedge1 (unhedged beta=1 spread z), z_hl (half-life-scaled residual z), z_corr (level-correlation-scaled z). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and hedge-z-vs-relative-value-vs-halflife-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.signals: hedge-ratio beta=cov_L(p_i,p_m)/var_L(p_m) on log-price LEVELS; resid=(p_i-mean_i)-beta*(p_m-mean_m); z=resid/std_L(resid); spread_z=-z; spread_zxs=-(z-mean_j z); z_hedge1=-z of unhedged (beta=1) spread; z_hl=-z/(1+half_life) with half_life=-ln2/ln(phi) (AR(1) of resid, clipped [0,500]); z_corr=-z*clip(corr_L(p_i,p_m),0,1); score=-mispricing (long cheap/short rich); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0. p_m=equal-weight cross-sectional mean log-price.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute; a lookback without enough valid observations yields NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vs hedge_z/relative_value/halflife vs placebo (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns, same reference positions); shares = |net| / sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
